## What and why / 무엇을 왜

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, build, tests, knowledge lint, public-content scan, licence check)
- [ ] No real drawings, project files, customer or personal data — examples are synthetic
- [ ] New or changed rules keep their ids stable and carry `title`, `title_en`, `condition`, `fix`
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`)
